summary: All 12 themes have a theme_contract.yaml naming only tables and columns the theme builds. A 96-hour advance of each clean seed writes at least 4 publication receipts with a real table hash. The five original themes opt into those publications with publish_receipts on seed.example.yaml, so historical seeds keep the recorded live.json fingerprint.

verification.output_root_reason: theme_phase2 was already in use by another verifier

publication_hook.mechanism: theme.yaml declares publishes on the nightly fact (and the load that feeds it, where one target per night is fewer than 4 receipts in 96 hours). publication_opt_in copies those targets into var/world/live.json only when the seed sets publish_receipts: true. seed.example.yaml sets it. world/seed.example.yaml and the GT fixture builders do not, so their fingerprinted live section is unchanged.

logs: Each theme's generator writes deterministic var/logs/ingest_daemon.log, sftp_sync.log, and scheduler_audit.log from the virtual clock. All 12 built worlds contain those three files.
